name: Scrambled eggs
method:
1. Beat the eggs with the milk.

2. Melt the butter in a pan over low heat.

3. Add the eggs and gently stir until fully set. Serve immediately.

name: Tomato omelette
method:
1. Chop the tomato and beat the eggs.

2. Heat the oil in a pan and soften the tomato.

3. Add the eggs and cook over low heat until fully set. Fold and serve.

name: Cheese toast
method:
1. Spread the butter on the bread and place the cheese on top.

2. Cook under a grill until the cheese melts and the bread is toasted. Serve warm.

name: Mashed potato
method:
1. Peel and cut the potatoes. Place in a covered microwave-safe bowl.

2. Microwave until tender, stirring and checking regularly.

3. Mash with the milk and butter. Heat through before serving.

name: Tomato pasta
method:
1. Chop the onion and tomatoes. Cook the onion in the oil, add tomatoes and simmer into a sauce.

2. Bring the measured water to the boil in a separate pot. Add pasta and cook until tender, stirring regularly.

3. Drain remaining water and mix the pasta with the sauce.

name: Egg fried rice
method:
1. Simmer the rice in the measured water until tender and the water is absorbed.

2. Heat oil in a pan, add peas and cook through.

3. Add beaten eggs and stir until fully set. Add rice and stir until piping hot. Serve immediately.

name: Carrot soup
method:
1. Chop the carrots and onion.

2. Heat the oil in a pot and soften the onion. Add the carrots and water.

3. Simmer until the carrots are tender. Mash or blend carefully and serve hot.

name: Banana oats
method:
1. Combine oats and milk in a saucepan.

2. Simmer gently, stirring until thick and cooked.

3. Slice the banana over the oats and serve.

name: Apple porridge
method:
1. Chop the apple into small pieces.

2. Combine apple, oats and milk in a saucepan.

3. Simmer gently, stirring until the oats are cooked and the apple softens.

name: Rice pudding
method:
1. Place rice, milk and sugar in a saucepan.

2. Simmer over low heat, stirring frequently until the rice is tender and the pudding thickens.

3. Serve warm.

name: Potato hash
method:
1. Cut the potatoes into small cubes and finely chop the onion.

2. Heat oil in a pan. Add potatoes, cover and cook over medium-low heat, turning regularly until tender.

3. Add onion and continue cooking until softened and the potatoes are golden.

name: Mushroom eggs
method:
1. Slice the mushrooms and beat the eggs.

2. Melt butter in a pan and cook the mushrooms until soft.

3. Add the eggs and stir until fully set. Serve warm.

name: Tomato sandwich
method:
1. Slice the tomato.

2. Spread butter over the bread.

3. Add the tomato slices, close the sandwich and serve.

name: Pea rice
method:
1. Bring rice and water to a gentle simmer in a covered saucepan.

2. When the rice is almost tender, add peas and butter.

3. Continue cooking until the rice is tender and the peas are cooked through.

name: Cheese omelette
method:
1. Beat the eggs and grate the cheese.

2. Melt butter in a pan, add eggs and cook over low heat.

3. Add cheese, fold and continue cooking until the eggs are fully set.

name: Carrot and potato soup
method:
1. Chop the carrots, potatoes and onion into small pieces.

2. Place all vegetables in a pot with the measured water.

3. Simmer until tender, then mash or blend carefully and serve hot.

name: Banana milk
method:
1. Peel and slice the banana.

2. Blend with the milk until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Buttered pasta
method:
1. Bring the measured water to the boil and add pasta.

2. Cook until tender, stirring regularly, then drain.

3. Stir through butter until melted and serve.

name: Warm tomato beans
method:
1. Chop the onion and tomatoes. Drain the cooked beans if needed.

2. Heat oil in a pan and soften the onion. Add tomatoes and simmer into a sauce.

3. Add the cooked beans and heat through. Use cooked or canned beans, not raw dried beans.

name: Pepper and onion eggs
method:
1. Chop the pepper and onion and beat the eggs.

2. Heat oil in a pan and cook the vegetables until soft.

3. Add the eggs and stir until fully set. Serve warm.
